title: Positive sectional curvature on the exotic 8-sphere and order-three homotopy 10-spheres: a Lean formalisation
description: A machine-checked formalisation in Lean 4 and Mathlib of the arguments in Fernando Galaz-García, Positive sectional curvature on the exotic 8-sphere and order-three homotopy 10-spheres, arXiv:2609.38126. The formalisation includes a reusable Riemannian geometry library.
